1346322908650631168.a:
Grades felt like an obedience test to me. I more than aced most tests. Kindergarten teacher told my mother I was stupid to my face because I didn't know colors. I told her that she was stupid because it said red-orange right on the label. She shrank two sizes in her chair. 😑 Tweet by @NotABombBunkE

https://x.com/NotABombBunkE/status/1346188280354779138

1346325380597243904.a: That day she realized I was fluent in English, math, etc. The rest of the class talked like babies. The teacher gave me 12th grade reading comprehension test I aced. She went to the principal afraid she would be fired for taking me out of class to play in the sandbox all year.

1346325381813567488.a: In 3rd grade they simply took me out of class and sent me to the lunchroom all day and sent random kids who couldn't understand scientific method. If school isn't teaching you need information please don't stop improving yourself. No one else will take the time. You'll thank you.

1346325951286804480.a: Also, I absolutely loved the sandbox. As bad as she thinks that was it was actually the only thing she could've done. Everyone else was so far behind. There were building blocks and tools there. She never seemed to notice what I was doing over there.
